title: Kults CropXP
description: This datapack adds xp drops to most crops as a configurable amount at a 50% drop rate.
body:
By default crops will drop 1 xp point at a 25% drop chance.

### Supported Crops

* Wheat
* Carrots
* Potatos
* BeetRoot
* Melons
* Pumpkins
* Netherwart
* Cocoa Beans
* Berries (Currently not working)

#### Unplanned but may add if there's a demand:
Sugarcane, Cactus, Bamboo, Glow Berries, Sniifer Plants, and Mushrooms

This pack was made in 1.21.11 and has not been tested elsewhere.

## Commands
To see the commands in this datapack as well as default values, run:

```
/function cropxp:config
```
This will show you the amount of XP each crop drops. Default 1.

To change this value use:

```
/function cropxp:CROP_NAME {value:X}
```
For example /function cropxp:wheat {value:37}

Before deleting the datapack from your folder run:

```
/function cropxp:uninstall
```
This will remove custom background data that may linger otherwise.
